scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -b packages/api packages/backup packages/cron
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/api packages/backup packages/cron && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/backup/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cron/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['api','backup','cron']) for (const d of ['dist','build-test','.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync('packages/'+p+'/'+d,{recursive:true,force:true})"
